primaryUseCase: single-instrument target exposure; shared policy across BTC/ETH/SOL, independent capital accounts, no portfolio allocation claim

data.availability: ASSUMED closeTime+1ms; no historical first-seen witness; promotion blocked
data.license: Binance provider terms; do not redistribute raw data
data.contamination: All rows are already exposed development data: earlier 45 adaptive trials and the September sequential screen. New methods are adaptive successors, not independent confirmation.
data.holdout: No final holdout read or allocation. Existing 1227 returns and carry outcomes through 2027-01-20 remain protected. No raw full snapshots or collectors.

partition: Stops exclusive; rewards mature strictly before trainStop. Six inherited separation bars are conservative, not a claim of an additional embargo; forward-only training has no post-test embargo region. Evaluation contains 64 transitions per symbol/fold, one cash start and one terminal close, never reset to hide a failure.

environment.observation: causal-close-inventory-v3 plus support flag, remaining finite-horizon fraction, pending target; explicit new 12-input version, incompatible with legacy policies
environment.normalization: Each episode fits only its strictly pre-decision burn-in with causal_replay_v3; immutable thereafter. No outcome-based calibration or predictor fits.
environment.actionSemantics: Raw categorical proposal remains the learning action. Decision support projection remains v1. At next-close simulated fill, compute the immutable exact-kernel preview. Only turnover_limit triggers a fresh zero-target execution from the ORIGINAL state; the rejected preview is never committed or charged. With partial fills, zero is a target, not a claim of immediate flatness. Other economic termination and resource failures remain unchanged.
environment.ledger: replay-accounting-v2 exact bounded rational unit ledger, initial equity 1, futures PnL and event funding, 5bp fee+0.5bp half-spread+4.5bp slippage, terminal costs exactly once
environment.reward: Economic ledger and evaluation reward remain 100*(equity_after-equity_before). Only PPO training receives economicReward - 0.02*int(actionChanged). Penalty is 2bp of initial equity per changed proposal, an operational preference, NOT an exchange cost. No clipping or other shaping. Preserve economic ledger rows and archive both rewards for every training transition.
environment.discountRationale: Gamma=1 for a finite 64-transition economic objective with costed terminal liquidation, matching evaluation. Remaining fraction is observed; neither market observability nor stationarity is assumed. No bootstrap beyond economic or declared finite-objective termination; batch boundaries bootstrap as before.
environment.execution: Proposal at completed close; old units earn PnL/funding before fill at following close. Price-taking exogenous history, no market impact calibration. Delay stress holds one pending permitted target; next proposal may be ignored while a reservation is pending, explicitly logged.
environment.risk: Same v1 limits. A pre-fill admissible position has exposure <=0.35, so a zero target with fill in (0,1] requires turnover <=0.35 <0.50. Cost-induced economic risk still terminates and blocks adoption. This is isolated simulated recovery, not an operational live fallback.
environment.unsupported: zero target in isolated simulator, with costs; not a claim that flattening is an operationally safe live fallback
environment.limits: No authentic precision/min-notional/liquidity/queue calibration; no live inference or shared production reservations; blocks integration. Rational arithmetic exhaustion fails the trial, never silently rounds or resets.
environment.intervention: Log support unavailable separately; actionChanged means decision support changed the proposal or final turnover admission changed a due target. Scheduling/deferred/ignored proposals are reported separately, not called risk interventions. Final horizon liquidation is separately logged.
environment.penaltySemantics: Use the existing actionChanged boolean: support projection or final turnover admission change. Deferred/ignored proposals and terminal liquidation alone do not count. No mask, action decoder, support bound, or risk-gate change. This non-potential penalty changes the objective and has no policy-invariance or CPO constraint guarantee.
environment.training: No training in this campaign; v5 unshaped and v6 penalized weights immutable.

riskGates.interventionDefinition: actionChanged; old unsupported/deferred reason flag preserved separately, not directly comparable

champion: Preserved. Exact live adopted-combo snapshot/causal replay not available in main; do not substitute a proxy and claim comparison. PR330 is separate evidence, not an imported baseline.
baselineContract: Cash and constant-long use no extra information. Normalized momentum/reversal take only sign of observation[1], the normalized three-bar return. They measure deviation from burn-in mean, not raw trend. Reuse the vector-only supplemental v2 implementation. No raw-history comparator is a primary baseline.
hypothesis: Stochastic categorical extraction of frozen PPO may differ economically and in shield intervention from greedy extraction. Test both unshaped v5 and penalty v6 with no retraining; original greedy evaluations were valid for their registered deployed decoder. This is a decoder sensitivity, not a new algorithm or confirmatory search.
decoder: categorical-inverse-cdf-v7: stable existing softmax logits, validate finite nonnegative length3 sum within1e-12, divide by sum, inverse CDF with half-open intervals; u in [0,1). Log normalized raw proposal probabilities, uniform, action index, proposal log probability and all unchanged shield/ledger stages. Zero probabilities never selected. No masks or epsilon mixing. These are simulator raw proposal probabilities, not real behavior propensities or executed-action densities.
randomness: NumPy2.3.5 PCG64 SeedSequence([actionSeed,fold,trainingSeed,symbolIndex]). Reset per independent replay; common uniforms across packages and stresses for paired comparisons. Each episode draws once per decision, no cross-episode state. Five action seeds quantify conditional Monte Carlo variability; not independent markets or five additional trained policies.
selection: No training/checkpoint/seed selection. All20 frozen PPO artifacts, two extraction modes.2100 stochastic +420 greedy +168 rule replays =2688 planned. Greedy and rule paths must reproduce parent within1e-12 with exact discrete fields. Any failure retained; no replacement or silent reset. No future candidate selected from these adaptive results.
primaryStatistic: For each package: stochastic minus its own greedy mean total net equity change; also stochastic versus cash and normalized_momentum3. Six preregistered contrasts, paired chronological increments. Materiality0.001 and positive simultaneous lower bound plus unchanged risk gates required even for development eligibility; external adoption blockers persist.
statistics: Average five action replicas, five training seeds and three symbols before resampling each chronological fold; balanced complete design equivalent to uniform row mean. Circular blocks3/9/21,2000 draws,seed20261010,Bonferroni six contrasts. Failed/short paths mean insufficient evidence, retained realized endpoints reported separately. Report all seed/action-seed dispersion, costs, interventions and stresses. No cumulative adaptive error control; DSR/PBO insufficient.
ope: Model-based historical counterfactual under unchanged price-taker simulator. No real behavior logs, support, IS/DR/FQE or ESS claim.
proofGates: strict frozen archive and artifact identity, shape, version and reward contract
inverse CDF boundary, zero mass, invalid input, seeded reproducibility and golden NumPy choice conformance
all greedy and deterministic controls reproduce frozen parent
independent ledger audit on every realized path
reuse existing exact arithmetic/lifecycle/causal proof artifacts, with source binding; no new floating-point theorem or production assurance
limits: Already consumed two64-transition windows per symbol. No new final holdout, authentic availability, matched champion, precision/liquidity calibration, real OPE, production integration or Haskell12-input inference. Three learners previously trained (PPO, simulator DDQN, fixed simulated-data CQL); only PPO decoder is evaluated here. No new profitability claim.
